content:
Thank you all for your contributions and feedback, we just published the latest basic-cli release.

https://github.com/roc-lang/basic-cli/releases/tag/0.26.0

  • better alignment or consistency of terminology across API's
  • time now has types
  • improved support for Streams and chunked API's to avoid materialising everything in memory at once
  • OS specific API's
  • improvements to Cmd and SQLite
  • Windows no longer requires Visual C++ Build Tools (can someone please test and confirm :thank_you: )
  • various bug fixes
I can confirm I did not have to do anything on Windows and it just worked, after 0.25.0 failing
